Hi Samira,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we’re aligned for procurement/security review: 

- Redwood summary: we covered deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated), data residency options, and our standard retention/configuration defaults.
- Primary asks you raised: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability for your workflows, and an initial vendor security questionnaire.
- IR/BCP ask: you requested breach-notification timelines and artifacts (IR playbook, BCP/DR summary, recent drill evidence).

Can you confirm:
1) Preferred format for vendor questionnaires (Excel/PDF)?
2) Any internal SLA for receiving third-party SOC/IR artifacts (example: 72 hours)?
3) Who on your side will own the legal/compliance review (I’ll route artifacts there)?

Internal notes: Ben — can you prepare a redacted SOC 2 executive summary and sanitized IR/BCP docs we can share? Laura — if there are any legal caveats, flag them before I send.

Goal: send an initial package (summary + sanitized artifacts) and a completed questionnaire back to Acadia by EOD Thursday (2026-11-05) if that timeline works for them.

Thanks —
Hiro

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Acadia Health — data protection, SOC 2 & IR timelines

Hi Hiro — thanks for the recap and the call. Quick answers + attachments:

1) Questionnaire: Excel is preferred (I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire).
2) Timeline expectations: our legal/compliance team expects initial artifacts within 5 business days; for any incident notification policy we require confirmation that the vendor will notify us within 72 hours of confirmed breach discovery (we can discuss exceptions for large-scope investigations).
3) Review owners: I'll be primary (Security), and Catherine Lee in Legal (catherine.lee@acadiahealth.com) will do contract-side review.

Specific asks from the questionnaire and our call:
- SOC 2 Type and date (Type II preferred; if we can get a recent summary or bridge letter that helps).
- HIPAA applicability confirmation (PHI handling: yes/no + controls).
- IR playbook: we need high-level steps for detection, containment, notification, and evidence preservation.
- BCP/DR overview and most recent tabletop/test date (we will want the date and scope; we don’t need every log).

I attached: Acadia_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Happy to do a 30-min follow-up early next week after we review your artifacts.

Best,
Samira

Hiro/Laura — quick inventory and proposed package:

1) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the 12-month period ending 2025-09-30. Legal prefers we send a redacted executive summary rather than the full report for initial reviews. Attachment: redwood_soc2_executive_summary_2025.pdf (sanitized).

2) IR artifacts: We can share a sanitized IR runbook that outlines detection, escalation paths, containment criteria, and notification steps (no internal IPs or call-signs). Attachment: redwood_ir_runbook_sanitized.pdf.

3) BCP/DR: We can provide a one-page BCP/DR overview doc and a summary of most recent tabletop (June 2026). Attachment: redwood_bcp_dr_overview.docx.

4) HIPAA/GDPR: We do handle customer-designated PHI with appropriate contractual controls for private deployments; for hosted API customers we have controls and a BAA process — Laura, please confirm the exact language we should use in the questionnaire about BAAs.

5) Timeline: We can assemble the initial package and return the completed questionnaire by 2026-11-05 EOD PDT. For breach notification policies, standard Redwood process is to notify customers within 72 hours of confirmed incident discovery where customer data may be impacted — we need legal to approve any phrasing.

I’ll attach the three artifacts above for Hiro to send. Laura, flag anything that needs legal caveats.

Ben Carter
